verdict.rationale: Per-institution health is a fair question for an open-banking aggregator like Yapily, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers payment-status webhooks, institution feature flags (e.g. INITIATE_EMBEDDED_ACCOUNT_REQUEST) and consent re-authorisation. None of these are institution status pages, outage or degradation signals, or error codes that separate a bank-side failure from an integrator-side one, so there is no evidence the story is delivered.
